SELECT * FROM prepay_order
AND (student_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR student_phone LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND order_status=#{orderStatus} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.student_name,o.student_phone,o.product_id,p.course_content product_content, o.product_amount,o.discount_amount,(o.product_amount-o.discount_amount) payable_amount,o.order_status FROM prepay_order o JOIN order_product p ON p.id=o.product_id WHERE o.student_phone=#{phone} AND o.order_status='PENDING_PAYMENT' ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.student_name,o.student_phone,o.product_id,p.course_content product_content, o.product_amount,o.discount_amount,(o.product_amount-o.discount_amount) payable_amount,o.order_status FROM prepay_order o JOIN order_product p ON p.id=o.product_id WHERE o.id=#{id}
